name: The Alchemist's Science Lab
provenance: Original SVG illustrations authored for Recall Rally. No third-party images, fonts, runtime dependencies or external asset requests.

assets.role: Layered stone-and-copper laboratory room, without UI or characters
Recurring professor with normal and surprised expression groups
Original engraved brass/copper chassis, glass routes, gauges, wood-inlaid pedestal; dynamic potion layers inserted at build/runtime
Potion-only illustration of the established Fizzwick design, with curious/excited/startled/celebrating expression layers

interactive_art: src/science-lab.js renders five distinct SVG machines from actual experiment steps. The existing renderGameHero supplies the customized player. Assets and machines are embedded in index.html and the standalone build. PotionMixerArt in src/science-lab-potion.js builds five distinct clipped glass vessels, progress-dependent liquid/drive states and bounded transition effects. The other four equipment renderers and original professor asset are unchanged.
motion: CSS-only equipment and character reactions, disabled by prefers-reduced-motion; no new frame loop or external animation library.
